# Run.app
> Run.app is a cloud platform for deploying, running, and scaling containerized applications and jobs.

Run.app provides managed infrastructure for running containers with support for services, jobs, networking, storage, observability, and developer workflows.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://run.app/docs): Main entry point for platform documentation and product guides.
- [Getting Started](https://run.app/docs/getting-started): Introductory guide for deploying your first application on Run.app.
- [Deployments](https://run.app/docs/deployments): Documentation for creating and managing application deployments.
- [Services](https://run.app/docs/services): Guides for configuring long-running service workloads.
- [Jobs](https://run.app/docs/jobs): Documentation for running one-off and scheduled job workloads.
- [Networking](https://run.app/docs/networking): Guides for ingress, routing, and network configuration.
- [Storage](https://run.app/docs/storage): Documentation for persistent and attached storage options.

## Core Concepts
- [Projects](https://run.app/docs/projects): Overview of project organization and resource isolation.
- [Regions](https://run.app/docs/regions): Information about deployment regions and workload placement.
- [Containers](https://run.app/docs/containers): Guidance on container images, runtime expectations, and configuration.
- [Environment Variables](https://run.app/docs/environment-variables): How to define and manage runtime environment variables.
- [Secrets](https://run.app/docs/secrets): Managing sensitive configuration and secret injection.
- [Scaling](https://run.app/docs/scaling): Configuration for autoscaling and workload capacity behavior.
- [Health Checks](https://run.app/docs/health-checks): Readiness and liveness checks for reliable deployments.

## Deployment & Operations
- [Builds](https://run.app/docs/builds): Build and image preparation workflows for application deployment.
- [Releases](https://run.app/docs/releases): Managing rollout lifecycle and release versions.
- [Rollbacks](https://run.app/docs/rollbacks): Restoring previous versions after a failed deployment.
- [Logs](https://run.app/docs/logs): Accessing and interpreting application and platform logs.
- [Metrics](https://run.app/docs/metrics): Monitoring workload performance and operational metrics.
- [Troubleshooting](https://run.app/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues and diagnostic steps for deployments.
- [Custom Domains](https://run.app/docs/custom-domains): Configuring custom hostnames and domain routing.

## API & CLI
- [API Overview](https://run.app/docs/api): Overview of programmatic access to Run.app resources.
- [API Reference](https://run.app/docs/api/reference): Endpoint-level reference for the Run.app API.
- [Authentication](https://run.app/docs/api/authentication): API authentication methods and credential handling.
- [CLI Overview](https://run.app/docs/cli): Introduction to the Run.app command-line interface.
- [CLI Installation](https://run.app/docs/cli/installation): Install and configure the Run.app CLI locally.
- [CLI Commands](https://run.app/docs/cli/commands): Reference for available CLI commands and usage patterns.
- [Webhooks](https://run.app/docs/webhooks): Event delivery and webhook integration documentation.

## Guides
- [Deploy a Web App](https://run.app/docs/guides/deploy-web-app): Step-by-step guide for deploying a web application.
- [Deploy a Worker](https://run.app/docs/guides/deploy-worker): Guide for running background worker processes on Run.app.
- [Run Scheduled Jobs](https://run.app/docs/guides/scheduled-jobs): Configure recurring jobs and scheduled execution.
- [Connect a Database](https://run.app/docs/guides/connect-database): Guidance for attaching and using external databases.
- [Zero-Downtime Deployments](https://run.app/docs/guides/zero-downtime-deployments): Practices for safe rollouts without service interruption.
- [Private Networking](https://run.app/docs/guides/private-networking): Set up internal connectivity and restricted network access.
- [Production Readiness](https://run.app/docs/guides/production-readiness): Checklist and recommendations for production deployments.

## Security

- [Access Control](https://run.app/docs/security/access-control): Managing users, roles, and permissions.

- [Data Protection](https://run.app/docs/security/data-protection): Information about encryption and data handling practices.
- [Compliance](https://run.app/docs/security/compliance): Compliance posture and supported standards.

## Integrations
- [GitHub](https://run.app/docs/integrations/github): Connect GitHub repositories for deployment workflows.
- [GitLab](https://run.app/docs/integrations/gitlab): Integrate GitLab with build and deployment pipelines.
- [Container Registry](https://run.app/docs/integrations/container-registry): Use external registries for storing and pulling images.
- [Terraform](https://run.app/docs/integrations/terraform): Infrastructure as code workflows using Terraform.
- [Monitoring Integrations](https://run.app/docs/integrations/monitoring): Connect external monitoring and observability tools.
- [CI/CD](https://run.app/docs/integrations/ci-cd): Automate builds and deployments from CI/CD systems.
